RC Aviation Apparel

Tell me which ones you'd wear

These are designs I've drawn up — RC flying stuff, for us. Any of them can go on a t-shirt, and most work as a sticker or on a mug. Nothing's printed yet, and I'm not ordering a pile of anything: it's print-on-demand, so a design only ever gets made if someone actually wants it.

Hit ▲ Yes or ▼ Nah on each one. Don't worry about what it goes on — that comes later. Just: would you wear it? Skip anything you don't care about. Tap a picture to see it bigger, and use Hide done at the bottom to shrink the list as you go.
